passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Wealth and children won't avail disbelievers against Allah; companions of Fire abiding eternally; parable of worldly spending like frost-laden wind destroying crop of self-wrongers; Allah did not wrong them but they wronged themselves; prohibition of taking intimates from outside ranks who spare no corruption; hatred appeared from mouths what breasts conceal greater; clear signs if you reason; you love them they don't love you; you believe in all scripture; when meet say we believe alone bite fingertips in rage; say die in rage; Allah knows what is in breasts; good touching you grieves them evil striking you rejoices them; patience and taqwa neutralize their plot; Allah encompasses what they do

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٖ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتۡ حَرۡثَ قَوۡمٖ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَأَهۡلَكَتۡهُۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنۡ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ بِطَانَةٗ مِّن دُونِكُمۡ لَا يَأۡلُونَكُمۡ خَبَالٗا وَدُّواْ مَا عَنِتُّمۡ قَدۡ بَدَتِ ٱلۡبَغۡضَآءُ مِنۡ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَمَا تُخۡفِي صُدُورُهُمۡ أَكۡبَرُۚ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

هَـٰٓأَنتُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمۡ وَتُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوۡاْ عَضُّواْ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۚ قُلۡ مُوتُواْ بِغَيۡظِكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
إِن تَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ حَسَنَةٞ تَسُؤۡهُمۡ وَإِن تُصِبۡكُمۡ سَيِّئَةٞ يَفۡرَحُواْ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تَصۡبِرُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ لَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطٞ

mainSubject.label: Futility of material wealth and progeny against divine judgment; eternal damnation of disbelievers; parable of worldly expenditure as destructive frost-wind annihilating harvest of self-wrongers; divine justice affirmed: Allah did not wrong them, they wronged themselves; prohibition of intimate alliances (bitanah) with those outside the faith who actively seek Muslim ruin; exposed hatred vs concealed malice; divine clarification of signs for those who reason; asymmetry of affection: believers love hypocrites who reciprocate with hidden rage; biting fingertips in private as sign of suppressed fury; command to declare 'die in your rage'; divine knowledge of innermost thoughts; emotional Schadenfreude of enemies toward Muslim fortune/misfortune; sabr and taqwa as shield against enemy plotting; divine encompassment of all actions

notes: Pass A Imran passage 14/16. Frost-wind parable (3:117) unique agricultural metaphor for futility of godless charity. Bitanah prohibition (3:118) establishes loyalty boundaries. Fingertip-biting imagery (3:119) vivid psychological portrait. Sabr-taqwa pairing (3:120) as strategic defense formula.
